data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 120.9m (2020: GBP 473.6m) is a deterioration of GBP 0.8m pre LPT (2020: deterioration of GBP 7.9m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end.

prior_year_events.event_name: External reinsurance to close of 2018 & prior years to Premia Managing Agency Limited's Syndicate 1884
prior_year_events.impact_description: Removal of brought forward technical provisions for the 2018 & prior years from opening claims balances via an external RITC adjustment.
2020 was heavily impacted by the unprecedented Covid-19 pandemic; the Syndicate reported a favourable movement in Covid-19 losses of GBP 1.3m in 2021.

prior_year_events.event_name: High frequency of natural catastrophe events
prior_year_events.impact_description: A high frequency of natural catastrophe events adversely impacted 2020 results and contributed to elevated claims in that year.

named_events.event_name: Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) agreement with RiverStone (syndicate 3500)
named_events.loss_description: Premium ceded to RiverStone of GBP 14m (of which GBP 4m will earn through in future calendar years); net impact to the Syndicate under the LPT is a 0.3% improvement on the combined ratio.

named_events.event_name: Part VII transfer to Lloyd's Brussels
named_events.loss_description: Policies and related liabilities underwritten in the EEA were transferred to Lloyd's Brussels on 30 December 2020 and reinsured back to the Syndicate; the combined effect had no economic impact for the Syndicate.
1:100 AEP modelled exposure: Gross Loss GBP 10.5m, Final Net Loss GBP 5.9m.
1:100 AEP modelled exposure: Gross Loss GBP 3.0m, Final Net Loss GBP 1.4m.
Directors consider the impact on future profit and net assets could be material but too early to reliably estimate; being monitored closely.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate opened 2021 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 770.971m. During 2021 there was a small adverse prior-year reserve movement (deterioration) of GBP 0.8m (net, pre-LPT) identified against claims reserves established at the prior year end, representing approximately 0.10% of opening gross claims. The financial statements were affected by an external RITC adjustment which removed GBP 327.542m of 2018 & prior technical provisions from opening balances, and by a Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) ceded to RiverStone (GBP 14m premium ceded) which improved the combined ratio. Drivers referenced for reserve movements include residual COVID-19 effects, a high frequency of natural catastrophe events (notably North Atlantic hurricane and US earthquake peril exposures), and general adverse claims development; reinsurance transactions (RITC/LPT) materially influenced reported opening and movement balances.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year reserve movement (PYD) figure was found. The report explicitly states a NET deterioration of GBP 0.8m to prior year reserves; per extraction rules, the NET figure has been used as a fallback and flagged accordingly. The gross claims development triangle only contains 2019 and 2020 underwriting years (the two most recent years) so it cannot be used to compute PYD per the rules. The opening claims were materially adjusted by an external RITC (removing GBP 327.542m) which distorts simple movement comparisons.
